map.依据 CDMA MEID 规则校验 14 位十六进制移动设备识别码的格式与校验位: Per CDMA MEID rules, validate the 14-hex-digit mobile equipment identifier's format and check digit; for device identity verification and inventory management (format check only, not authenticity).
map.校验 MEID 为 14 位十六进制或 18 位十进制格式: Validate MEID as 14 hex or 18 decimal format
map.CDMA 设备入库、维修时核对设备识别码: Verify the equipment identifier when CDMA devices enter inventory or repair
map.验证十六进制与十进制两种表示是否自洽: Verify the hex and decimal representations are self-consistent

map.MEID 的两种写法？: What are the two MEID notations?
map.14 位十六进制与 18 位十进制（首位常为 0）表示同一设备标识，可相互换算。: 14 hex and 18 decimal (first digit often 0) represent the same device identifier and convert to each other.
map.MEID 和 IMEI 的区别？: What is the difference between MEID and IMEI?
map.MEID 用于 CDMA 网络设备，IMEI 用于 GSM/UMTS/LTE 设: MEID is for CDMA network devices, IMEI for GSM/UMTS/LTE devices; the two differ in format and length.
map.校验通过代表设备合法吗？: Does passing validation mean the device is legal?
map.不代表。设备是否在网、是否报失须由运营商数据库确认。: No. Whether the device is on-network or reported lost must be confirmed in the operator's database.
